text: You want to use OpenAI to build a mental health bot that is helpful, reliable, and safe for users. Yes, this can be done by combining a carefully scoped conversational flow with retrieval, safety rules, and human-in-the-loop escalation for higher-risk cases. The main challenge is not whether an LLM can respond, but whether the system can consistently avoid unsafe advice, handle crisis language, and stay within clear boundaries. I’ve built healthcare NLP systems before, including a clinical note summarisation model for Brightwell Clinics using Python, Hugging Face Transformers, Flan-T5, and PEFT; it achieved ROUGE-L 0.41 and cut clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial. My main questions are: what exact use cases should the bot support, and what guardrails or escalation paths do you want for urgent mental health situations?
